title: Return the right count
prompt: AfterArrivals(int open, int arrivals) should return the number of open tasks after the arrivals are added. The starter works out the total but returns something else. Repair it.
hints: Which variable holds the answer by the time the method reaches return?
return sends back the value of the expression after it.
Return total, or return open + arrivals directly.
checkLabels: An empty board with no arrivals must give 0.
An empty board with 4 arrivals must give 4.
No arrivals must leave the count unchanged.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Removes the arrivals instead of adding them.

feedback: Follow the failing call through the method. Check which name the return statement sends back.
